source_trace.observation: worker-transport is assigned only after Popen returned, duplicate-query handle close, full encoded request write, and stdin close. A spawn failure would retain worker-launch instead. temporarilySuspends=true is set after Popen, not proof of attachment.

_collect catches ordinary loop exceptions without retaining subtype or operation, and polls/waits/kills the owned worker during cleanup. Most caught loop errors become transport, while an exception escaping cleanup can reach the outer handler.

After phase worker-transport, the outer handler can also receive a TemporaryDirectory context-exit error. _failure_kind reduces OSError to os-error and does not retain errno/winerror or the exact boundary.
Final owned-worker cleanup separately classifies cleanup_unknown if its own operations raise. The actual status transport_failed supplies no evidence of a final-cleanup exception.
